# Source clerk and assembler brief v03 — first used on scan021

This is a source-only support role. Root decides every ink locus. Read only the current page's supplied text packet, reader returns explicitly released by root, root's crop journal, and the source structure needed for this job. Do not open images, crop, OCR, compile, render, research, install, delegate, or perform optional mathematical or coordinate computations. An existing finite computation must be copied with its actual scope and source; do not rerun it. The independent readers' original files remain unchanged.

## Record preparation

Preserve each actual reader difference, doubt, inventory row, graphical component, literal path and report-silent TeX choice with its original identity and exact source pointer. A compact source crosswalk can reference stored original files; every source must resolve unambiguously. Keep the actual C doubt-table row identity, with compound parts separately recorded. Notation, abbreviation and slip tables retain their actual source scope. Existing manuscript source words, accents, cancellation states and graphical components remain literal.

Make every public decision's `readers` mapping contain A, B and C. A reader's absence from its difference list supplies no reading. Use that reader's actual complete TeX excerpt, scope and reference for any report-silent choice. Preserve raw reported mappings separately and state source absence only within an inspected complete source span. The public builder consumes `readers` directly.

Every root-selected S confirmation must contain `S_id` and `S_status`; the builder uses those fields to display its identity. An S confirmation whose overbar is already present in C and H has zero C/H counts. An S row's broad range supplies no unobserved local example.

Use exact builder fields: `notes` is a string; `abbreviations` entries have `form` and `expansion` (the latter remains a probable expansion in the output heading); each doubt has `location`, `reading`, `alternatives`, `confidence` and `reason`; every inventory entry has the requested CSV fields and `transcribed: yes` only for selected source content. Preserve original alternate field names as provenance when needed.

## Counting and uncertainty

Root supplies all final count and confidence choices. One physical glyph/state/graphic cluster receives its selected count once. Shared H ill-placeholders or whole drawing replacements use one explicit parent; local component rows remain visible with zero duplicate count. Keep report rows and physical count loci separate. An actual C doubt resolution counts once; retaining the existing primary qualification, adding a supported alternative to it, or retaining an explicit blank alternative alone has no C count. A new qualification of previously firm content counts once. H's same primary reading with a changed editorial uncertainty marker alone has no H count; a changed primary with H's reading as a retained alternative remains qualified. Preserve each actual C status, including mixed component outcomes.

Every emitted row uses an allowed collation kind and an explicit `marked_in_H` Boolean grounded in the relevant H source or shared placeholder parent. Context used to anchor an omitted mark belongs in provenance; the public C/H reading must describe that mark's actual presence or absence.

## Exact selected-source assembly

Follow root's selected complete graphical group, including its adjacent words, nodes, scope translations, origin, baseline and local qualification. Retain each physical stroke once. A separately selected replacement cannot duplicate an overlapping component or adjoining word. The first occurrence per page carries a recurring-symbol unsure wrapper; later occurrences retain the selected primary while their independently inspected local doubts stay in the record.

The selected draft and source map must agree byte for byte. Supply complete source blocks, literal replacements, exact final offsets and attachment pointers for decisions, inventory and doubts. Every selected literal path must be traceable. Do not claim metric or rendered validation of manual drawing approximations. Keep physical paragraph blanks outside math delimiters.

The final source review is one targeted pass over actual coverage, source identities, selected exact text/paths, public fields, physical count parents and attachments. Narrow repairs found by that pass receive bounded follow-up. Preserve the earlier audit hashes and the exact scope of each repair. Do not broaden testing once the required defect is closed.

## Root handoff

Leave `main_adjudicated` and each `main_approved` false in the draft. Give the exact frozen draft/map/record hashes, current audit hash, counts, original C outcome counts and any actual unresolved issue. All public A/B/C fields, S identities and abbreviation fields must already be complete. Root reads the final selected source and record, approves it, and runs the structural commit gate. The gate binds the selected bytes to the final page and rebuilds all cumulative outputs before the next page starts.

Current approval fields in the committed record describe the completed approval. Earlier pending flags remain only in raw draft/proposal history. No source clerk declares root approval or writes a final page commit.


## Revision v02 — first used after scan019, for scan020 source roles

The final source map includes draft_sha256_utf8 equal to its selected draft's exact UTF-8 SHA-256; retain other established final-hash fields as aliases. Record attachments consumed by approve_page.py use checks/scanNNN_final_draft.tex relative to out/, and preserve the exact correspondence to the map's workspace-relative out/checks/... path. The final approval gate changes only current selected approval fields; raw reader/proposal flags remain historical. Current original C parts retain their original pending decision_status separately when the gate writes their approved outcome status.

Distinguish root_ink_choice_applied from root_source_audit_choice_applied for S coverage and administrative conventions. Both require their exact root-journal source; a source-only row does not falsely claim an ink choice.

Prepare a brief attributed mathematical-content note from the selected text before the final source freeze. Its quotations and displayed statements have exact selected source spans, including prose adjoining a display. The page's written i.e. or analogous assertion stays attributed and unverified unless an actual check was performed. Preserve complete provenance without converting transcription or source bookkeeping into a theorem check.


## Revision v03 — first used after scan020, for scan021 source roles

The current public evidence and doubt reasons describe the selected completed source. A root crop journal can legitimately say that a drawing will be supplied before it is built; preserve that journal exactly as provenance, then use the actual selected group name and completed state in the public record. Likewise, selected inventory descriptions and positions use the final resolved/qualified state; original tentative descriptions remain in source provenance. State exactly what H's apparatus describes: an upper label description does not itself supply a brace drawing.

Keep the public English `notes` field brief and substantive. Include the actual written count or expression and attributed assertion, the author's own doubt/correction wording, dates/page counts that occur, and mathematics-led ink decisions. Retain the full source, viewing, ownership, attachment, original-row/count and audit bookkeeping in structured provenance. Exact CONTENT source spans and a longer prior note may be preserved there without printing that bookkeeping in the public note.

At root approval, the gate now marks current top-level main_approved and the selected decisions, doubts, inventory, original C parts, selected_graphical_groups, source_locus_coverage, abbreviations, attributed_content_note and root_selected_content_note. Raw reader/candidate/source-group histories and the frozen draft/map retain their original flags. Tell root about any genuinely new current selected approval field that falls outside these named views; do not recursively rewrite raw history. The source audit and bounded closure retain their actual old/new hashes, including exact public wording changes, without repeating a full source pass.

| 21 | right-hand brace | curly braces enclose dotted i | `K_1\cup\{i\}` |

| 21 | corollary | two-stem Π topped by a small right-hand ring | `\Pi_I^\circ`, also `0` |
| 21 | last brace | flat bar above first V, single ink point above second V | `\overline V`, `\dot V` |
| 21 | end of proof and corollary | single-stroke lower-case abbreviation, with final dot | `cqfd.`, `comp.` |
| 21 | central union, after X ∖ | High cross-stroke on the left stalk of the round union. | `\rlap{\raisebox{.65ex}{$\scriptstyle-$}}\bigcup \| \bigcup` |
| 21 | first display, conclusion and corollary | Small prose marks next to formulas; read independently of the signed capital sigmas. | `i.e, cqfd., comp.` |

## Doubtful readings
| Scan | Location on sheet | Reading | Other readings | Confidence | Evidence on this sheet | Contextual preference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 21 | opening after je dis que | l'on a | on a | medium | Broad loop then two short separate strokes. | The surrounding text does not settle this reading. |
| 21 | between first two intersections | i.e | i.e. | low | Cursive two-part sign; a separate final point is indistinct. | The surrounding text does not settle this reading. |
| 21 | beginning of next line | (ce | Ce | medium | Tall left hook beside the small ce; no clear matching closing parenthesis. | The statement continues through comme dans le lemme without a corresponding close. |
| 21 | under K = K₁ ∪ {i} | Σ_α | — | low | Angular top and a low curl survive the diagonal cancellations. | The surrounding terms use Σ with a low α index. |
| 21 | after Or | comme | — | medium | The beginning is retraced and the middle loops run together. | The surrounding text does not settle this reading. |
| 21 | small lead-in to brace diagram | j.e. | i.e. | low | The left stem descends and returns below the baseline, unlike the shorter i of the upper equivalence. | The upper display uses i.e for an equivalent formulation. |
| 21 | sideways between the braces | upright ! between sideways labels | sideways ou / dash | low | Read along the sigmas, a point precedes a short line; with the page upright the line is above the point. | ou occurs between the same signed sigmas at the top of the upright column. |
| 21 | third upright row of diagram | Σ_{iα} | Σ_{i,α} | medium | Small dotted hook drawn at the right end of sigma before the low α. | The surrounding text does not settle this reading. |
| 21 | after α₀ ∈ K₁ | signifi | signifie | medium | Dot and two short strokes at the baseline; the final vowel is indistinct. | The following formula supplies the complement of signifie. |
| 21 | word struck after ce qui | impli | impl. | low | Small initial dot and tall loop under the line. | The live replacement signifie follows the cancelled beginning. |
| 21 | below exclusion | signifie | — | medium | The e consists of a separate short stroke. | The preceding sentence has the same verb. |
| 21 | corollary, Π exponent | circle | 0 | medium | Same small ring as on 20. | The surrounding text does not settle this reading. |
| 21 | last brace, old glyph under E | V | — | medium | Two thin obliques survive through the new E. | V with a dot stands in the same short clause. |
| 21 | Eᵢ ⊂ U display, large union | round union with a high left cross-stroke | round union | high | The horizontal crosses the left stalk and stops inside the cup. The plain unions above and below lack the stroke. | The surrounding text does not settle this reading. |
| 21 | Eᵢ ⊂ X display, far right | α₀ | α | medium | A small, mostly filled low stroke follows the loop of α; the 0 is clearer in the preceding subscript. | The preceding complement and the following sentence both use α₀. |

## Slips kept as written
| Scan | Location | As written | Apparent intention | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 21 | opening, first Σ | hat Σ_{α₀}, with no + | hat Σ_{α₀}^+ | The later E_i inclusion gives this roofed sigma a superscript +. |
| 21 | middle equality | Σ_α^- | Σ_{α₀}^- | The immediately preceding hatted term carries the further 0; the right side has a low alpha with no distinct 0. |
| 21 | last line | X ∖ Σ_α | X ∖ E_α | The lemma on scan 20 writes π₀(X ∖ E_α). The bottom line here has an angular Σ. |

\page{20}
Soit $\alpha_0\in K_1$, je dis que \uncertain{on a} :
\[
\widehat{\Sigma}_{\alpha_0}\cap\widehat{\Sigma}_i^+ = \emptyset \quad
\text{i.e.}\quad \Sigma_{\alpha_0}\cap\Sigma_i = \emptyset
\]
(ce qui achèvera la démonstration, car on aura
\[
U = X\setminus\bigcup_{\alpha\in K}\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+ \qquad
\bigl|\ K = K_1\cup\{i\}\ \struck{\ill{}}
\]
comme dans le lemme.

Or \struck{\ill{}} \ill{} :
\[
E_i\subset U_{J,i} = X\setminus\bigcup_{\alpha\in K_0}
\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+
\]
ce qui implique que
\[
E_i\subset X\setminus\widehat{\Sigma}_{\alpha_0}^+ = \Sigma_{\alpha_0}^-
\]
i.e.
\note{à droite, un schéma vertical : de haut en bas $\Sigma_i^+$ ou
$\Sigma_i^-$, $E_i$, $\Sigma_\alpha$, $E_\alpha$, $\Sigma_{\alpha_0}^+$,
réunis par une accolade}
d'autre part $\alpha_0\in K_1$ signifie
\[
\Sigma_{\alpha_0}^+\not\subset\Sigma_i^+
\]
ce qui \struck{implique} signifie aussi que
$\Sigma_i^+\cap\Sigma_\alpha^+=\emptyset$, cqfd.

\emph{Corollaire du lemme} Pour une classe $V$ de $\Pi_I^0$, son
expression
\[
V = X\setminus\bigcup_{\alpha\in K}\widehat{\Sigma}_\alpha^+
\]
du lemme précédent est \emph{unique} — on a
\[
\begin{cases}
K = \{\alpha\in I \mid \overline{V}\cap E_\alpha\neq\emptyset \ \text{ i.e. }\ E_\alpha\cap\dot{V}\neq\emptyset\}\\
\Sigma_\alpha^+ \text{ est l'unique comp.\ de } X\setminus E_\alpha
\text{ contenue dans } X\setminus V
\end{cases}
\]
\note{le corollaire, encadré d'un trait vertical, s'arrête au bas du
feuillet ; la suite est au lot suivant}

\end{document}

def graphic(gid,box,base,paths,nodes=(),qual=None,annotation=None,owner='',crop=None,components=None):
    lines=[f'% {gid} BEGIN; source bbox={box}; source origin=({box[0]},{box[1]}); baseline y={base}; owns: {owner}',f'\\begin{{tikzpicture}}[x=.055mm,y=-.055mm,baseline=({gid}base),line cap=round,line join=round]',f'\\path[use as bounding box] ({box[0]},{box[1]}) rectangle ({box[2]},{box[3]});',f'\\coordinate ({gid}base) at ({box[0]},{base});']
    if annotation: lines += [f'% invisible complete reading/state annotation: {annotation}',f'\\node[overlay,anchor=base west,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at ({box[0]},{base}) {{\\phantom{{${annotation}$}}}};']
    lines+=paths
    for x,y,t in nodes: lines += [f'\\node[anchor=base west,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at ({x},{y}) {{${t}$}};']
    lines += ['\\end{tikzpicture}',f'% {gid} END']
    body='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
    if qual: body='\\unsure{% '+qual+'\n'+body+'}\n'
    groups.append({'tex_fragment':body,'id':gid,'bbox':box,'source_origin':[box[0],box[1]],'baseline_y':base,'coordinate_map':'full-scan coordinates retained in each independent picture; physical x=.055 mm per pixel, physical y=-.055 mm per pixel; declared rectangle fixes local extent; labels anchor=base west, inner/outer sep=0','owner':owner,'qualifier':qual,'annotation':annotation,'crop':crop,'path_commands':paths,'nodes':[{'source_anchor':[x,y],'anchor':'base west','text':t} for x,y,t in nodes],'components':components or []})
    return body

def sig(gid,box,base,head,body,idx,raised=None,hat=None,crop=None,qual=None,extra=(),annotation=None):
    paths=[r'\draw[line width=.45pt] '+head+';',r'\draw[line width=.45pt] '+body+';']
    if hat: paths.append(r'\draw[line width=.45pt] '+hat+';')
    paths+=list(extra)
    nodes=[]
    if idx:nodes.append(idx)
    if raised:nodes.append(raised)
    return graphic(gid,box,base,paths,nodes,qual,annotation,'complete Sigma, its separate head, index and any raised sign/hat; no adjoining relation or word',crop)

Its final line writes $X\setminus\Sigma_\alpha$.

No interrogative author assertion or question word was selected. Author corrections are the cancelled Sigma-alpha, the cancelled impli/impl. group, and the overwritten V beneath E. Reader uncertainties remain explicitly marked.

# Scan 021 — independent reader B

The author writes \(\widehat\Sigma_{\alpha_0}\cap\widehat\Sigma_i^+=\varnothing\), followed by `i.e` and \(\Sigma_{\alpha_0}\cap\Sigma_i=\varnothing\). He continues the written inclusion/exclusion argument to `cqfd.`. The first hatted Sigma has no raised plus.

Under **Corollaire du lemme**, the author calls the expression \(V=X\setminus\bigcup_{\alpha\in K}\widehat\Sigma_\alpha^+\) unique. His written conditions use \(\overline V\cap E_\alpha\ne\varnothing\), `i.e.` \(E_\alpha\cap\dot V\ne\varnothing\), with an overwritten V under that second E; the final line names \(X\setminus\Sigma_\alpha\). These are manuscript assertions. No proof or mathematical computation was checked.

## Notation table
| Scan | Location on sheet | Mark as seen | LaTeX reading and alternatives |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 21 | first equality | alpha with a smaller zero, doubly lowered; hats on first two sigmas only | `\widehat{\Sigma}_{\alpha_0}`, `\widehat{\Sigma}_i^+` |
| 21 | right-hand brace | curly braces enclose dotted i | `K_1\cup\{i\}` |
| 21 | E_i inclusion and margin | ordinary U below a leading diagonal, X with difference slash; five upright rows with transverse sigma labels | `U_{J,i}`, `\setminus`; sideways `\Sigma_i^-`, `\Sigma_i^+` |
| 21 | corollary | two-stem Π topped by a small right-hand ring | `\Pi_I^\circ`, also `0` |
| 21 | last brace | flat bar above first V, single ink point above second V | `\overline V`, `\dot V` |
| 21 | end of proof and corollary | single-stroke lower-case abbreviation, with final dot | `cqfd.`, `comp.` |
| 21 | central union, after X ∖ | High cross-stroke on the left stalk of the round union. | `\rlap{\raisebox{.65ex}{$\scriptstyle-$}}\bigcup \| \bigcup` |
| 21 | first display, conclusion and corollary | Small prose marks next to formulas; read independently of the signed capital sigmas. | `i.e, cqfd., comp.` |

from pathlib import Path
import json,re
p=Path('out/readers/021/C'); tex=(p/'reading.tex').read_text()
r=json.loads((p/'report.json').read_text()); s=json.loads((p/'source_audit.json').read_text()); g=json.loads((p/'graphical_groups.json').read_text())
# Inventory ordering and original source identities are administrative provenance.
ypos={1:65,2:140,3:265,4:385,5:490,6:645,7:725,8:810,9:1030,10:1070,11:1125,12:935,13:1195,14:1305,15:1380,16:1433,17:1680,18:1815,19:1900,20:2040,21:2135,22:2180,23:419,24:1818,25:2227,26:1935,27:398}
source_map={n:f'021.{n:02d}' for n in range(1,18)};source_map.update({18:'021.17',19:'021.18',20:'021.19',21:'021.20',22:'021.21'})
for item in r['inventory']:
 suffix=item['element'].split('.')[-1]
 if suffix.isdigit():
  n=int(suffix)
  if n in ypos:item['page_order_y']=ypos[n]
  else:
   loc=next((d for d in r['differences'] if d['location']==item['position'] and d.get('bbox')),None)
   item['page_order_y']=loc['bbox'][1] if loc else 0
  if n in source_map:item['source_C_element']=source_map[n]
 elif suffix.startswith('M'):
  d=next(d for d in r['differences'] if d['id']=='C021-'+suffix);item['page_order_y']=d['bbox'][1]
 else:item['page_order_y']=2350
r['inventory'].sort(key=lambda z:(z['page_order_y'],z['element']))
precise={
'C021-R01':("l'on a",['on a']),
'C021-R05':('comme',[]),
'C021-R06':('j.e.',['i.e.','j:e.','i:e.']),
'C021-R07':('upright !',['sideways ou','sideways dash']),

stack=[]; errors=[]

# Scan021 — reader C

The author writes the two empty intersections beginning with \(\widehat\Sigma_{\alpha_0}\cap\widehat\Sigma_i^+=\varnothing\), gives \(K=K_1\cup\{i\}\), and ends the proof with \(\Sigma_i^+\cap\Sigma_\alpha^+=\varnothing\) and “cqfd.” The underlined corollary calls \(V=X\setminus\bigcup_{\alpha\in K}\widehat\Sigma_\alpha^+\) unique and writes its final complement as \(X\setminus\Sigma_\alpha\). These are the manuscript's assertions; no proof check was performed.

## Line-by-line reading audit

| Position | Selected reading and local qualification |

| opening | Soit alpha0 in K1, je dis que l'on a / on a; no colon — half a and crop01 |
| first formula | \widehat Sigma_alpha0 has no +; \widehat Sigma_i has +; right Sigmas have no roofs; i.e has no final point — crops18,19,02 |
| parenthesis | (ce qui ach[è / é / e]vera la [demonstration / démonstration], car on aura; no close supplied — crop03 |
| upper U and condition | U=X\setminus union_{alpha in K} roofed Sigma_alpha+; K=K1 union {i}; deleted Sigma_alpha; comme dans le lemme. — half a,crops04,20 |
| Or line | Or qualified comme on a; no colon and no added word — crop05 |
| central inclusion | E_i subset U_{J,i}=X\setminus cup-with-cross-run_{alpha in K0} roofed Sigma_alpha+ — crop06 |
| second inclusion | cela implique que; E_i subset X\setminus roofed Sigma_alpha0+ = Sigma_[alpha0 / alpha]- — half a,crop07 |
| margin | G05 owns j.e./i.e. cluster, top Sigma_i+ ou Sigma_i-, E_i, qualified Sigma_i alpha/i,alpha, E_alpha, Sigma_alpha0+, both sideways Sigma_i-/Sigma_i+, central sign and two braces — crop08 |

| conclusion | ce qui deleted[impli / impl.] signifie aussi que Sigma_i+ cap Sigma_alpha+ = empty, cqfd. — crops10,22 |

| bottom K set | bar V cap E_alpha != empty i.e. deleted V/live E_alpha cap dot V != empty; enclosing set braces present — crop13 |
| last condition | Sigma_alpha+ est l’unique comp. de X\setminus Sigma_alpha contenue dans X\setminus V; no final point — crop13 |
| archive | 20, comment only; no manuscript page marker or cotefile command — half b |

## Original C doubt rows

The original source table has fifteen rows, each retained under its original order and identity. All have a local crop. Seven are resolved and eight retained.

## Marks and limits

The literal groups preserve the upper cancelled Sigma, the two cancelled-word crossing runs, the overlaid V/E correction, the two marginal braces and transverse labels, the lower looped brace, the central union cross-stroke, the corollary union retrace, and the individual short Sigma head runs. The first repeated head-role ambiguity carries its printed qualifier; later local alternatives remain in the report. Six detached shape groups retain explicit uncertainty about their role, hand and surface origin.

The first roofed Sigma has no written plus. The first “i.e” has no final point. Both live occurrences of “signifie” are selected with their short final e. The author writes \(\widehat\Sigma_{\alpha_0}\cap\widehat\Sigma_i^+=\varnothing\), followed by `i.e` and \(\Sigma_{\alpha_0}\cap\Sigma_i=\varnothing\). He continues the written inclusion/exclusion argument to `cqfd.`. The first hatted Sigma has no raised plus.

Under **Corollaire du lemme**, the author calls the expression \(V=X\setminus\bigcup_{\alpha\in K}\widehat\Sigma_\alpha^+\) unique. His written conditions use \(\overline V\cap E_\alpha\ne\varnothing\), `i.e.` \(E_\alpha\cap\dot V\ne\varnothing\), with an overwritten V under that second E; the final line names \(X\setminus\Sigma_\alpha\). value.C_notation_rows_source:
## Notation table
| Scan | Location on sheet | Mark as seen | LaTeX reading and alternatives |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 21 | first equality | alpha with a smaller zero, doubly lowered; hats on first two sigmas only | `\widehat{\Sigma}_{\alpha_0}`, `\widehat{\Sigma}_i^+` |
| 21 | right-hand brace | curly braces enclose dotted i | `K_1\cup\{i\}` |
| 21 | E_i inclusion and margin | ordinary U below a leading diagonal, X with difference slash; five upright rows with transverse sigma labels | `U_{J,i}`, `\setminus`; sideways `\Sigma_i^-`, `\Sigma_i^+` |
| 21 | corollary | two-stem Π topped by a small right-hand ring | `\Pi_I^\circ`, also `0` |
| 21 | last brace | flat bar above first V, single ink point above second V | `\overline V`, `\dot V` |
| 21 | end of proof and corollary | single-stroke lower-case abbreviation, with final dot | `cqfd.`, `comp.` |
| 21 | central union, after X ∖ | High cross-stroke on the left stalk of the round union. | `\rlap{\raisebox{.65ex}{$\scriptstyle-$}}\bigcup \| \bigcup` |
| 21 | first display, conclusion and corollary | Small prose marks next to formulas; read independently of the signed capital sigmas. | `i.e, cqfd., comp.` |
value.C_slips_raw:
| Scan | Location | As written | Apparent intention | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 21 | opening, first Σ | hat Σ_{α₀}, with no + | hat Σ_{α₀}^+ | The later E_i inclusion gives this roofed sigma a superscript +. |
| 21 | middle equality | Σ_α^- | Σ_{α₀}^- | The immediately preceding hatted term carries the further 0; the right side has a low alpha with no distinct 0. |
| 21 | last line | X ∖ Σ_α | X ∖ E_α | The lemma on scan 20 writes π₀(X ∖ E_α). The bottom line here has an angular Σ. |

/notes/1/text.excerpt: "The author labels Corollaire du lemme and calls V=X\\setminus\\bigcup_{\\alpha\\in K}\\widehat\\Sigma_\\alpha^+ unique. # Scan021 — reader C

The author writes the two empty intersections beginning with \(\widehat\Sigma_{\alpha_0}\cap\widehat\Sigma_i^+=\varnothing\), gives \(K=K_1\cup\{i\}\), and ends the proof with \(\Sigma_i^+\cap\Sigma_\alpha^+=\varnothing\) and “cqfd.” The underlined corollary calls \(V=X\setminus\bigcup_{\alpha\in K}\widehat\Sigma_\alpha^+\) unique and writes its final complement as \(X\setminus\Sigma_\alpha\). These are the manuscript's assertions; no proof check was performed.

## Line-by-line reading audit

| Position | Selected reading and local qualification |
| --- | --- |
| opening | Soit alpha0 in K1, je dis que l'on a / on a; no colon — half a and crop01 |
| first formula | \widehat Sigma_alpha0 has no +; \widehat Sigma_i has +; right Sigmas have no roofs; i.e has no final point — crops18,19,02 |
| parenthesis | (ce qui ach[è / é / e]vera la [demonstration / démonstration], car on aura; no close supplied — crop03 |
| upper U and condition | U=X\setminus union_{alpha in K} roofed Sigma_alpha+; K=K1 union {i}; deleted Sigma_alpha; comme dans le lemme. — half a,crops04,20 |
| Or line | Or qualified comme on a; no colon and no added word — crop05 |
| central inclusion | E_i subset U_{J,i}=X\setminus cup-with-cross-run_{alpha in K0} roofed Sigma_alpha+ — crop06 |
| second inclusion | cela implique que; E_i subset X\setminus roofed Sigma_alpha0+ = Sigma_[alpha0 / alpha]- — half a,crop07 |
| margin | G05 owns j.e./i.e. cluster, top Sigma_i+ ou Sigma_i-, E_i, qualified Sigma_i alpha/i,alpha, E_alpha, Sigma_alpha0+, both sideways Sigma_i-/Sigma_i+, central sign and two braces — crop08 |
| next argument | d'autre part alpha0 in K1 signifie; Sigma_alpha0+ not subset Sigma_i+ — crops09,11 |
| conclusion | ce qui deleted[impli / impl.] signifie aussi que Sigma_i+ cap Sigma_alpha+ = empty, cqfd. — crops10,22 |
| corollary heading | Corollaire du lemme underlined; Pour une classe; no heading punctuation — half b |
| first corollary line | V de Pi_I^[circle / zero], son expression — half b,crop12 |
| corollary expression | V=X\setminus union_{alpha in K} roofed Sigma_alpha+; no added endpoint punctuation — crop21 |

| bottom K set | bar V cap E_alpha != empty i.e. deleted V/live E_alpha cap dot V != empty; enclosing set braces present — crop13 |
